status_as_of_cutoff: approved-permitted: Uinta County's approved CUP index links CUP-26-01 for Prometheus Wyoming I LLC, and the county-hosted CUP decision/order is indexed as a June 16, 2026 Conditional Use Permit for the Evanston-area data center. Prometheus Hyperscale and local reporting state the Uinta County Board of Commissioners unanimously approved the CUP on June 16, 2026 for a roughly 506-acre, 1.25 GW initial-capacity campus near Evanston. Construction/energization remain unverified; the developer says construction is anticipated within six months of final permitting, and local reporting describes permit conditions including a five-year construction-start deadline and filings for other federal/state/local permits.
